description: Celestia staking economics and what it costs to run a validator, from Unity Nodes Pulse: staking APR, inflation, the share of supply that is staked, annual provisions, Pulse's reference monthly server costs per hosting provider (minimum, recommended and archive tiers), the stake at which a validator on each provider breaks even at an assumed 20% commission, and the estimated monthly operator earnings of the largest validators. Mainnet only, a snapshot refreshed every 15 minutes. The reference hardware prices are curated by Unity Nodes and can lag the market: for live server prices use list_datacenter_offers. For the TIA price use get_network_state.
name: get_celestia_economics
